描述_EN: due to its fragility, this tray was more a decorative than a functional item. this lacquer tray was decorated with a landscape scene made out of tiny pieces of mother-of-pearl. these were painstakingly applied on the surface, giving an iridescent quality to the decoration.
描述_ZN: 由于它的脆弱性，这个托盘更像是一个装饰品，而不是一个功能性物品。 这个漆器托盘上装饰着用小块珍珠母制作的风景图。 这些都是精心涂抹在表面的，给装饰带来了彩虹般的质量。
